english.title: Throw / drop / leave an item / substance at / on the Midland Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without authorisation

(A)_[threw an item or substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM OR SUBSTANCE..), at]_
(B)_[dropped an item or substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM OR SUBSTANCE..) upon]_
(C)_[left an item or substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM OR SUBSTANCE..) on]_

a part of the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) such as would obstruct or endanger the safe and efficient operation and working of the system
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(1)(c) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
